pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   D. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   C. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
